steps.title: Resuspend pellet in HCl
steps.instruction: Resuspend the cell pellet in 0.4 N HCl (125 µL per 1×10⁶ cells) by soft pipetting until no clumps remain; vortex softly if necessary.

steps.title: Incubate on rotator
steps.instruction: Incubate the suspension on a rotator for 4 h at 4 °C to lyse nuclei and solubilize histones.

steps.title: Add TCA dropwise
steps.instruction: Add trichloroacetic acid (TCA) drop‑by‑drop to the middle of each tube to a final concentration of 33 % (61.25 µL per 1×10⁶ cells), then invert the tube several times to mix.

steps.title: Ice incubation for precipitation
steps.instruction: Incubate the tubes on ice for 30 min to precipitate the histones.

steps.title: Remove supernatant carefully
steps.instruction: Carefully remove the supernatant without disturbing the pellet, which may be invisible or smeared on the tube wall.

steps.title: Dry acetone residue
steps.instruction: Air‑dry the pellet at room temperature for 30 min until no acetone remains.

steps.title: Resuspend histones in water
steps.instruction: Resuspend the dried pellet in milliQ water (50 µL per 1×10⁶ cells).

steps.title: Transfer aliquot for gel
steps.instruction: Transfer 20 µL (from 400 000 cells) to a new Eppendorf tube for subsequent gel loading.
